translation:
[#P04The] singularity has been successfully
erased.

[#P04In] the lower left corner of the screen, the
remaining singularities and goal…
…will decrease when a singularity is erased.

You will clear the stage when the number of
remaining singularities is zero.

However, if you allow the time limit to reach
zero first…
…it will result in Time's Up instead.
If the goal is reached by then…

…the stage will then be cleared. But if the
goal is not met…
…it will then result in a Game Over.

[#P04Pressing] the Y button will show the pause
screen…
[#P04]…allowing you to review the entire map.

[#P04On] the full map you will be able to see mater-
ialized singularities and area search results.

[#P04While] you are on the pause screen time is
stopped…

[#P04]…so you may review the situation at your
leisure.

However please note that singularities not
fully erased will still restore themselves.

[#P04The] pause screen also displays things such
as power ups, special ability levels…

[#P04]…and more information useful for forming a
strategy.

[#P04In] order to destroy all of the singularities
before the time limit…
[#P04]…it is important to investigate efficiently.

[#P04With] the area search, you can search all the
tiles one space away from the Brigade member.

But it cannot materialize any of the
singularities.

[#P04Investigate] wide areas efficiently so the
results do not overlap with each other…

…and you will be able to quickly deduce the
locations of the singularities.

Once the location has been deduced, promptly
perform a point search.

And then rub the materialized singularities
with your stylus to erase it.

Please remember that time is ticking away with
each unnecessary search.

[#P04It]'s important to diligently pause and
consider your strategy on the map.

[#P04This] is especially important if the Haruhi Meter
is low and you have few Topics.
